name: Acid Flask
description: Volatile green and yellow liquids swirl chaotically in the flask.
benefit: When thrown deals 1d3 acid damage to a target creature or object.

name: Alchemist's Fire
description: Volatile red and orange liquids swirl chaotically in the flask
benefit: When thrown deals 1d3 fire damage to a target creature or object.

name: Bottled Lightning
description: Electricity crackles slong a metal filament inside this small glass bottle.
benefit: When thrown deals 1d3 electrical damage to target creature.

name: Flash Powder
description: Coarse gray powder ignites and burns instantly.
benefit: When thrown DC11 CON or creature is blinded.

name: Holy Water
description: Pure water mixed with silver and gold flakes.
benefit: When thrown deals 1d6 damage to undead creatures.

name: Liquid Ice
description: Sealed jar that contains crystalline blue fluid that starts to evaporate once opened.
benefit: When thrown deals 1d3 cold damage to target creature.

name: Smelling Salts
description: Sharply scented gray and pink crystals.
benefit: Causes people inhaling them to regain consciousness.

name: Tanglefoot Bag
description: This small sack is filled with tar, resin, and other sticky substances.
benefit: When thrown DC11 DEX or creature is held in place.
